newsitem.title: USA: Illinois extends Clinton nuke shutdown.
newsitem.headline: Illinois extends Clinton nuke shutdown.

text.p: Illinois Power Co extended the shutdown of its 930 megawatt Clinton nuclear power plant in Clinton, Ill. to at least this weekend, a spokesman said.
"We may be in startup mode by Saturday," company spokesman John Dewey said Wednesday.

The company had expected the plant to resume operations near September 11, but pushed the restart back to complete and submit an evaluation report of recent repairs to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, Dewey said.
The plant was shut down Sept 6 for repairs to a recirculation pump seal.
Illinois Power is a unit of Illinova Corp.
